content.query:
--RLS

select *
----Select top 10 ddc.customerid
from dw.dimcustomer ddc
inner join dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
        on ddc.customersk = dca.customersk
inner join dw.dimbranch ddb
        on ddb.branchsk = dca.branchsk
where ddb.branchid = '1310'
and ddb.branchid <> '' 
and ddb.branchid is not null
and ddc.customerid like 'R%'
---and ddc.customerid = 'R00001258'



--MEASURES

--DEPOSITS

--MTD ADB
SELECT dca.CustomerID, SUM(distinct dmtd.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated) AS MTDADB,  dmtd.BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD dmtd
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dmtd.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
---WHERE dca.CustomerID = 'R00142428'
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID,  dmtd.BusinessDateSK

--YTD ADB
SELECT dca.CustomerID, dytd.BusinessDateSK, SUM(distinct dytd.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated) AS YTDADB
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD dytd
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dytd.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
----WHERE dca.CustomerID = 'P00762129'
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID, dytd.BusinessDateSK

--Outstanding Balance
SELECT distinct dca.CustomerID, SUM(distinct dob.BalanceAmountProrated) AS OB, SUM(distinct dob.BalanceAmountFull) AS OB_Full ----,dob.BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance dob
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca 
ON dob.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
WHERE dca.CustomerID = 'R00001258'
AND dob.BusinessDateSK = '20230601'
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID ---,dob.BusinessDateSK


---LOANS

--Loans Outstanding
SELECT DISTINCT dca.CustomerID, SUM(DISTINCT dre.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) AS Loans_Outbal, dre.BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure dre
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dre.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
--WHERE CustomerID = 'R01829862'
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID, dre.BusinessDateSK

--random check
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure dre
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dre.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
WHERE CustomerID = 'R02501110'--'R01829862'


--Due for the Month
SELECT DISTINCT dca.CustomerID, SUM(DISTINCT dlob.OutstandingBalanceProrated) AS AmtDue, dlob.BusinessDateSK----, dca.AccountSK
FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance dlob
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dlob.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
WHERE CustomerID = 'R01829862'----'R00007843'
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID, dlob.BusinessDateSK----, dca.AccountSK
ORDER BY dlob.BusinessDateSK

--random check
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance dlob
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dlob.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
WHERE CustomerID = 'R02501110'--'R00007843'
ORDER BY dlob.BusinessDateSK

--Loans Credit Limit
SELECT DISTINCT dca.CustomerID, SUM(DISTINCT dcl.CreditLimitAmountProrated) AS Credit_Limit, dcl.BusinessDateSK----, dca.AccountSK
FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit dcl
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dcl.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
WHERE CustomerID = 'R02501110'----'R00007843'
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID, dcl.BusinessDateSK----, dca.AccountSK
ORDER BY dcl.BusinessDateSK

--random check
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit dcl
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dcl.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
WHERE CustomerID = 'R02501110'
ORDER BY dcl.BusinessDateSK

------------------------------------------------------
--CREDIT CARDS
--Cards Outstanding
SELECT DISTINCT dca.CustomerID, SUM(DISTINCT dcre.RelationshipExposure) AS Cards_Outbal, dcre.BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure dcre
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dcre.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
--WHERE CustomerID = 'R01829862'
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID, dcre.BusinessDateSK

-------------------------------------------------------

---TRUST

---Fund Value

SELECT DISTINCT dca.CustomerID, SUM(DISTINCT dtfv.AUMAmountProrated) AS Fund_Value, dtfv.BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue dtfv
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dtfv.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
--WHERE CustomerID = 'R01769137'
WHERE dtfv.AUMAmountProrated IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID, dtfv.BusinessDateSK

--random check
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue dtfv
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dtfv.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
WHERE dtfv.AUMAmountProrated IS NOT NULL
---WHERE dca.CustomerID = 'R02116309'



-------------------------------------------------------

---TREASURY

---Fund Value

SELECT DISTINCT dca.CustomerID, SUM(DISTINCT dtoi.OutstandingInvestmentProrated) AS OutInvest_PHP, dtoi.BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment dtoi
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dtoi.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
--WHERE CustomerID = 'R01769137'
WHERE dtoi.OutstandingInvestmentProrated IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dca.CustomerID, dtoi.BusinessDateSK

--random check
SELECT * FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment dtoi
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount dca
ON dtoi.AccountSK = dca.AccountSK
---WHERE dtoi.OutstandingInvestmentProrated IS NOT NULL
WHERE dca.CustomerID = 'R00935374'
